name: Rammus
notes: Opening: Soaring Slam (R) is cast at t = 0 for its immediate impact damage (it has no cast time); if a very high-haste build brings its cooldown under the fight length it is recast again later on cooldown.

Powerball (Q) is modeled as an instant collision against the stationary dummy: per the dossier's unsettled question, the roll is read as colliding almost immediately after cast, dealing its magic damage burst once. Rammus then keeps channeling (the channel disables attacks) until the earliest allowed manual recast, 1 second later, which ends the channel and starts its cooldown post-effect, as the ability states.

Only one collision burst is credited per Q cast; the automatic end-of-duration recast at 6 seconds is never reached because the driver always manually recasts at the 1 second minimum to get the cooldown moving again.
Casting Q ends an active Defensive Ball Curl immediately (as the wiki states) and starts its cooldown early at that moment; this is modeled.

Defensive Ball Curl (W) is cast on cooldown purely for its indirect benefit: its bonus armor and magic resistance feed Spiked Shell's bonus AD. Its on-hit return-damage effect never triggers because the dummy never attacks, so it contributes nothing directly.
Defensive Ball Curl's percent armor/MR bonus is computed off the champion's base-plus-item armor/MR (not compounding on its own flat bonus), matching the wiki's 'flat + % of total' phrasing.
Spiked Shell's bonus AD (15% total armor + 15% total magic resistance) is recalculated live from current armor/MR, including Defensive Ball Curl's bonus while it is active.

The numbers sheet's RammusP.BaseDamage/TotalDamage entry looks like a data-extraction artifact (it references moveSpeed in an armor/MR formula); Spiked Shell is modeled exactly as the wiki states, with no flat base term.
Mana is not modeled: nothing in this rotation binds inside 15 s at level 16.

maxOrder is Q > W > E: E's damage never lands on a champion-classified dummy so ranking it contributes nothing, Q is the main repeatable magic-damage source, and W's rank raises its armor/MR (and therefore Spiked Shell's bonus AD).

unused.E: Frenzying Taunt's only damage component is against monsters; the fight's target is a stationary dummy that counts as an enemy champion, so E deals zero damage to it no matter when it is cast (casting it would only cost 0.25 s of cast lockout for no return).
